latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Email Sequence Builder skill.
- Generates ready-to-deploy email marketing sequences with subject lines, preview text, body, CTAs, and timing.
- Supports multiple sequence types: welcome, sales, nurture, re-engagement, onboarding, launch, webinar, abandoned cart.
- Outputs platform-ready formats for Markdown, Mailchimp (CSV), ConvertKit, and ActiveCampaign.
- Sequences follow best-practice copy rules and quality checks, including personalization and A/B testing for subject lines.
- Includes configuration files detailing sequence goals, triggers, segmentation, and KPIs.
